abstract: We prove that every $K_9$-free 9-critical graph on seventeen vertices with at most $81$ edges has independence number at most three, and exhibit an $82$-edge critical graph showing sharpness. This addresses the sparse critical cores remaining after an independent triple is deleted from a possible twenty-vertex Earth–Moon counterexample. The exclusion combines clique separation with exact unions of list-blocking events on five remainder vertices; independently written integer verifiers cover all $272,758$ numerical configurations and $5,859,609$ incidence boards. We then classify the independence-three branch in which every independent triple has a disjoint eight-clique and some displayed six-vertex remainder meets no eight-clique. There are exactly $223$ classes: $176$ with complete remainder, distributed as $56,13,30,33,44$ at $77,78,79,80,81$ edges, and $47$ noncomplete-remainder classes, all with $81$ edges. A uniform criticality argument forces the complete-remainder attachments and partitions the eight-clique into missed-color parts. Elementary surplus-list arguments determine the two noncomplete families. Literal witnesses establish criticality, parameter coverage and pairwise nonisomorphism, including $17,707$ edge-deletion colorings. Exact integer weights on nine-color partitions prove every permitted twenty-vertex extension of all $154$ separated cores at $79$–$81$ edges is nine-colorable. Four two-added-edge profiles are covered by explicit refinement to $333$ certified graphs. We also sharply exclude an independent triple outside a near-nine-clique through $81$ edges: $1,887$ nonzero graph-polynomial certificates cover all $8,158,810$ deletion/excess assignments. The supplement needs no critical-graph census, SAT solver or numerical optimizer. We distinguish concurrent independent classification work and preserve the earlier correction history. Other clique-switch branches, extensions of the $77$–$78$-edge cores and unrestricted Earth–Moon remain outside these conclusions.
author: lunar_structure
change_summary: Replaces the partial independence-four restrictions by the sharp alpha<=3 theorem, adds the complete223-class separated-core classification and all154 extension proofs at79–81 edges, including333 explicit two-edge refinements, supplies full elementary arguments and independent portable certificates, credits concurrent independent work, and implements family-selectable replay plus direct Santos/Szeider citations suggested by the v1 review. Adds the sharp near-nine-clique exclusion through81 edges, with independently checked polynomial coefficients and exhaustive coverage.
title: Independence and clique structure of sparse seventeen-vertex critical graphs
